# Beaverton, Oregon - Official Website

> Official city website for Beaverton, Oregon providing comprehensive guides to municipal services, permits, payments, and civic resources.

Beaverton is a city in Oregon that provides residents and businesses with access to city services, government information, and administrative resources through its official web portal powered by CivicPlus. The site serves as a central hub for permit applications, online payments, contact directories, and public information.

## Key Topics

- City Services
- Permits & Applications
- Online Payments
- City Council
- City Charter
- Non-Discrimination Policy
- Contact Directory
- How-To Guides
- Public Resources
- Government Services
- Beaverton Oregon
- CivicPlus
- CIVICS
- ArcGIS
